CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT
Effective date: 2026-09-01

Parties
This Consulting Services Agreement is between Northstar Analytics LLC, 410 Cedar Avenue, Seattle, WA 98101, and Cedar Health Systems Inc., 820 Lake Street, Bellevue, WA 98004.

Services
Northstar Analytics LLC will perform quarterly data-governance assessment and remediation recommendations.

Fees and Payment
Cedar Health Systems Inc. will pay USD 7200 within 20 days after invoice.

Term and Termination
The term is 12 months and either party may terminate on 60 days written notice.

Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by State of Washington.
